d: Watch the most celebrated evergreen superhit Hindi Song of Indian cinema 'Hansta Hua Noorani Chehra' from the Bollywood blockbuster balck & white hit classic movie 'Parasmani' (1963), starring Mahipal, Geetanjali, Helen, Maruti, Nalini Chonkar, Manhar Desai, Jeevan Kala, Aruna Irani, Jugal Kishore, Uma Dutt. Directed by Babubhai Mistri. Music composed by Laxmikant - Pyarelal. This song is sung by Lata Mangeshkar & Kamal Barot.
